Assign.description: 인덱스 문자열 키별 Time History Load Case 입력 값 (gvs1: SSOT planner)

ANAL_METHOD.description: Modal / Direct Integration / Static (Linear+Static 조합 거부)

allOf.description: When ANAL_TYPE = 0, ANAL_METHOD = 2 is not allowed
When ANAL_TYPE = 0 and ANAL_METHOD = 1, TH_TYPE = 1 is not allowed
When ANAL_TYPE = 1 and ANAL_METHOD in [0, 1], TH_TYPE = 1 is not allowed
When ANAL_TYPE = 1 and ANAL_METHOD = 2, TH_TYPE must not be provided

OUTPUT_STEP.description: Step Number Increment for Output (>= 1. Non-static: <= floor(ENDTIME/TIME_INC))

INC_STEP.description: Increment Steps (Nonlinear Static 시 실질 필수. 서버 >= 1 강제)

INIT_METHOD.description: Order in Seq Load / Initial Load (enum 노출. DB 0/1)

USE_INIT_LOAD.description: Use Initial Load (Defined in TMHS Global Control)

OPT_USE.description: Subsequent to (true 시 하위 필드 필수)

LCTYPE.description: Subsequent load case type (Static:ST, Construction Stage:CS, Time History:TH)

allOf.description: OPT_USE = false -> SUBSEQ_LOAD, LCTYPE, CASE must not be provided
OPT_USE = true -> SUBSEQ_LOAD required
SUBSEQ_LOAD = 0 -> LCTYPE, CASE required
SUBSEQ_LOAD = 1 or 2 -> LCTYPE, CASE must not be provided

CUM_DVA.description: Cumulate D/V/A Results (특정 조합에서만 의미 (INIT_METHOD/ORDER+LCTYPE 등))

KEEP_ACC.description: Keep Final Step Accelerations (특정 조합(Linear/Nonlinear Direct + ORDER+LC+TH)에서만 의미)

GEOM_NL_TYPE.description: None / P-Delta / Large Displacements (**DB 스왑**: Schema 1↔DB 2, Schema 2↔DB 1)

allOf.description: When INIT_METHOD = INIT, USE_INIT_LOAD is required and SUBSEQ must not be provided
When INIT_METHOD = ORDER, SUBSEQ is required and USE_INIT_LOAD must not be provided
For INIT method, when USE_INIT_LOAD = false, CUM_DVA and KEEP_LOAD must not be provided
For INIT method, when USE_INIT_LOAD = true, CUM_DVA and KEEP_LOAD are required
For ORDER method, CUM_DVA and KEEP_LOAD are allowed only when SUBSEQ is enabled, SUBSEQ_LOAD=0 and LCTYPE=TH
KEEP_ACC is enabled only when analysis is Linear Direct Integration, Nonlinear Direct Integration, or Nonlinear Static, and INIT_METHOD=ORDER with SUBSEQ OPT_USE=true, SUBSEQ_LOAD=0, LCTYPE=TH
GEOM_NL_TYPE is required only for Nonlinear Direct Integration/Static with INIT, or Nonlinear Direct Integration/Static with ORDER+SUBSEQ(OPT_USE=true,SUBSEQ_LOAD=0,LCTYPE=TH)
Nonlinear Direct/Static, ORDER+SUBSEQ(OPT_USE=true)이고 GEOM_NL_TYPE이 있을 때: [0,1(P-Delta)] → SUBSEQ_LOAD in [0,1]; 2(Large) → in [0,2] (SSOT runtime_constraints; Grid 3는 M1 미노출로 스키마 제외)

DAMPING_METHOD.description: Damping Method (DB 1~4 (±1 offset). Modal+Element(3) 조합 거부. Strain Energy/Element Mass&Stiff는 DAMPING_METHOD만 저장, 세부 파라미터 DTO 미노출)

MODAL_DAMPING_RATIO.description: Modal Damping Overrides (각 원소 MODE_NO(>0, 중복 금지) + DAMPING([0,1]))

DAMPING_METHOD.description: Damping Method (DB 1~4 (±1 offset). Modal+Element(3) 조합 거부. Strain Energy/Element Mass&Stiff는 DAMPING_METHOD만 저장, 세부 파라미터 DTO 미노출)

COEF_INPUT.description: Direct Specification / Calculate from Modal Damping (DB 1/2)

allOf.description: At least one of USE_MASS or USE_STIFF should be true
When COEF_INPUT = 0, COEF_CALC and modal input fields must not be provided
When COEF_INPUT = 0 and USE_MASS = true, MASS_VALUE is required
When COEF_INPUT = 0 and USE_MASS = false, MASS_VALUE must not be provided
When COEF_INPUT = 0 and USE_STIFF = true, STIFF_VALUE is required
When COEF_INPUT = 0 and USE_STIFF = false, STIFF_VALUE must not be provided
When COEF_INPUT = 1, direct coefficient values must not be provided
When COEF_INPUT = 1 and at least one of USE_MASS or USE_STIFF is true, COEF_CALC is required
When COEF_INPUT = 1 and COEF_CALC = 0, period inputs must not be provided
When COEF_INPUT = 1 and COEF_CALC = 1, frequency inputs must not be provided
When COEF_INPUT = 1 and both USE_MASS and USE_STIFF are true, first and second mode values are required
When COEF_INPUT = 1 and exactly one of USE_MASS or USE_STIFF is true, only first mode values are required and second mode values must not be provided

DAMPING_METHOD.description: Damping Method (DB 1~4 (±1 offset). Modal+Element(3) 조합 거부. Strain Energy/Element Mass&Stiff는 DAMPING_METHOD만 저장, 세부 파라미터 DTO 미노출)
Damping Method (DB 1~4 (±1 offset). Modal+Element(3) 조합 거부. Strain Energy/Element Mass&Stiff는 DAMPING_METHOD만 저장, 세부 파라미터 DTO 미노출)

allOf.description: When CTRL_OPT = 0, MAX_TRANS_DISP is required and node control values must not be provided
When CTRL_OPT = 1, MASTER_NODE, MASTER_DIR and MAX_DISP are required and MAX_TRANS_DISP must not be provided
When INC_METHOD = 0 (Load Control), SF is required and DISP_CTRL must not be provided
When INC_METHOD = 1 (Displacement Control), DISP_CTRL is required and SF must not be provided
When METHOD = 0, NEWMARK_METHOD, GAMMA and BETA must not be provided
When METHOD = 1, NEWMARK_METHOD is required
When METHOD = 1 and NEWMARK_METHOD = 2, GAMMA and BETA are required
When METHOD = 1 and NEWMARK_METHOD in [0, 1], GAMMA and BETA must not be provided

PERFORM_ITER.description: Perform Iteration (true 시 ITER_CTRL 서브 객체 의미)

OPT_USE.description: Displacement Norm (DISP/FORCE/ENERGY 중 최소 1개 true (서버 자동 대체))

allOf.description: OPT_USE = true then VALUE is required.
OPT_USE = false then VALUE is not allowed.

DISP.description: Displacement Norm (세 Norm 중 OPT_USE==true ≥1, dlg_api THIS runtime)

allOf.description: OPT_USE = true then VALUE is required.
OPT_USE = false then VALUE is not allowed.
OPT_USE = true then VALUE is required.
OPT_USE = false then VALUE is not allowed.

OPT_USE.description: Displacement Norm (DISP/FORCE/ENERGY 중 최소 1개 true (서버 자동 대체))

ITER_BEF_UPDATE.description: No. of Iterations before Stiffness Update (Custom 전용. FullNR→1 / InitStiff→51 자동)

DIVERGENCE_THRESHOLD.description: Divergence Threshold (DTO double, DB int 변환)

allOf.description: When OPT_USE = false, all child keys must not be provided
When OPT_USE = true, LINE_SEARCH_OPT is required
When OPT_USE = true and LINE_SEARCH_OPT = 0 (AUTO), detailed keys must not be provided
When OPT_USE = true and LINE_SEARCH_OPT = 1 (USER), detailed keys are required
ITER_BEF_UPDATE can be provided only when STIFF_UPD_SCHEME = 0
When STIFF_UPD_SCHEME = 1 or 2, ITER_BEF_UPDATE must not be provided
When PERFORM_ITER = false, ITER_CTRL must not be provided
When PERFORM_ITER = true or omitted, ITER_CTRL is required
COMMON basic required fields
ANAL_CASE basic required fields
Nonlinear Static only -> INC_STEP required, otherwise ENDTIME/TIME_INC and TH_TYPE required
Nonlinear Static -> INC_CTRL required, DAMPING and TIME_PARAM must not be provided; otherwise DAMPING required and INC_CTRL must not be provided
TIME_PARAM is enabled only when ANAL_METHOD = 1
NONL_CTRL_PARAM is enabled only when ANAL_TYPE = 1
For Nonlinear Modal, PERFORM_ITER is fixed to true
For Modal, DAMPING_METHOD can be [0, 1, 2]
For Linear Direct Integration, DAMPING_METHOD can be [0, 1, 2]
For Nonlinear Direct Integration, DAMPING_METHOD can be [0, 1, 2, 3]
DAMP_UPDATE is enabled only when ANAL_TYPE = 1, ANAL_METHOD = 1 and DAMPING_METHOD in [1, 3]
